title: Pilot Dispute
description: The frontmatter of a pilot dispute (XX): recorded when the pilot or crew find a contradiction, either between two commander records or between a commander record and the project's content. The body shows the disputed record or content on both sides and describes the contradiction. The commander settles it by amending or retiring their records, or by adding a CR to engage further work. Filed by identifier with a dash, XX-004.md.

type.description: the words Pilot Dispute, which is what chooses this schema

unit.description: this dispute's identifier, XX, a dash and three digits, the same identifier the file is named for

name.description: one to three words the writer chose for the record's contents, appended to the file name after the id (CA-049)

status.description: open while the contradiction is unresolved, settled once the commander has amended, retired or responded to it

stamp.description: three items: the date as YYYY-MM-DD, who wrote it, and the eight-character session id

context.description: the identifiers this dispute comes out of, a bracketed list, usually the order that prompted the sweep that found it; not where the contradiction itself lives, since one or both sides are often project content (the constitution, the codebase) with no identifier of their own. The old Rq, P, Or and De forms are accepted only until XD-005's citation sweep replaces them

sides.description: the two sides of the contradiction, named in a few words each, exactly two plain strings, matching the body's two headings that quote each side in full. Each side names a record id or a project path, never a line of a document

generates.description: the identifier of the commander response that settled this dispute, present once status is settled
